items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Papaline had a special band. We played a dance one night. It was cornet, Nicola Rocca, Martin Kirsch on clarinet, me on upright alto and drums.

ctx.x: Is there anything else you'd like to tell about your early New Orleans days, either playing with your family bands or the first dance jobs you played, who else was in the band?

Oh, I can't remember them now. So many fellows you've played. Papaline had a special band. We played a dance one night. It was cornet, Nicola Rocca, Martin Kirsch on clarinet, me on upright alto and drums. And we played the Lucky One dance hall up in Harvey and there were so many people in there, the thing fell in, the hall fell in.
